decisions.text: type bar: the parts mix positive and negative values: a regular bar chart, closed by a grey Total bar when the net total is part of the message (G0.15, G1.38, D-43)
values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
last: Total (catch-all, missing, total, then values not known)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
6 values against 7 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: $34K, $9K, $8K, −$4K, −$17K, $30K (G6.16, G7.4)
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “net donations”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
highlighted in the strong shade of their colour: East; the others keep their colour
good and bad coloured by the dividing value, 0 (higher is good): bad Central, West; good South, North, Total, East (G4.16)
the top label's words (“net donations”) in the colour of their side (G8.14)

static output, in colour: one file, red for bad and green for good, plain, for every reader (D-18; owner, 1 Oct 2026); black and white (audience.bw_risk) adds the textures, and a style may choose the colour-blind-safe pair (--good-bad-mode: safe-pair)

findings.message: East: its good/bad colour takes the place of the strong shade; highlight it by a border, a glow or an icon
findings.title: good values green and bad ones red, by the dividing value
